items.name: (LotV) Protoss Ancient Statues — Aiur Ruins
items.description: Close-up cinematic of large stone Protoss warrior statues on an Aiur jungle tileset, with Terran battlecruisers visible in the sky above.

items.description: Three Protoss hero units — a teal-armored warrior, a gold-shielded Adept-style figure, and a dark Tal'darim warrior — standing before ornate Protoss stone archways on a jungle tileset.
